prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up portrait of a man with a shaved head and trimmed beard, captured from the chest up against a smooth, gradient blue background that transitions from deep cobalt at the edges to a lighter, almost glowing blue at the center. The subject wears a vibrant green t-shirt and a chunky silver chain necklace, adding a bold, modern touch to his look. He is holding a pair of round, black sunglasses with both hands, pulling them down slightly to reveal his wide-eyed, surprised expression, which adds a playful and dynamic energy to the scene. His mouth is open as if in mid-exclamation, further emphasizing the sense of surprise or excitement. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows that enhance the contours of his face and arms, while the overall color palette is dominated by cool blues and greens, creating a fresh, contemporary atmosphere. The composition is tight and centered, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus sharply on the subject, giving the image a crisp, high-definition quality reminiscent of a modern music video or fashion editorial.
